resources.string: HTTP Toolkit is currently intercepting this device
To intercept this device, start HTTP Toolkit on your computer, and activate Android interception there via QR code or using ADB.
We couldn\'t connect to HTTP Toolkit.\n\nIs it running, and connected to the same network as this device?

Your HTTP Toolkit certificate is not trusted on this device, so HTTPS traffic will only be available from apps that individually include and trust it.\n\nDisconnect and reconnect to rerun HTTPS certificate setup.
HTTPS interception will only be available for apps that are configured to trust user-installed certificates.
Traffic from all intercepted applications will be available, except those using explicit certificate pinning.
Traffic from all intercepted applications will be available, except those using explicit certificate pinning.

Enter the address of an intercepting proxy running on your network. This is usually HTTP Toolkit on your computer, but Burp Suite is supported too.\n\nOn an emulator, use 10.0.2.2 to reach your computer.
IP address or hostname, optionally with a port (e.g. 192.168.0.10:8000)
The SHA-256 fingerprint of the proxy\'s public key, in base64 or hex. If set, the connection is rejected unless the proxy\'s certificate matches.
Without a fingerprint, whatever certificate this address returns will be trusted automatically. Only connect to addresses and networks you trust.
Enter a valid IP address or hostname
Enter a SHA-256 fingerprint in base64 or hex
That\'s an HTTP Toolkit QR code link. Use Scan/Paste QR code instead.
That address couldn\'t be found. Check it\'s spelled correctly, and that this device is on the same network.
The proxy refused the connection. Check the address and port, and that the proxy is listening for connections from other devices (not just localhost).
The proxy didn\'t respond in time. Check that it\'s running and on the same network as this device, and that your firewall allows connections to it.
Couldn\'t connect to the proxy. Check the address and port, and that it\'s reachable from this device.
This proxy requires authentication, which isn\'t supported. Turn off proxy authentication and try again.
Connected to the proxy, but couldn\'t download its CA certificate. HTTP Toolkit and Burp Suite are supported.
The certificate returned doesn\'t match the fingerprint you entered.
Connection failed. Check the address and port, then try again.
Scan HTTP Toolkit QR code to connect

HTTP Toolkit sets the device\'s HTTP proxy configuration, to capture traffic from all apps on any port, but some apps may ignore this.\n\nYou can add ports here to forcibly redirect all outgoing traffic to that port, but be careful, as this will interfere with any non-HTTP traffic on these ports.
